newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Hai-O gets nod for stock listing.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Hai-O gets nod for stock listing.

text.p: Malaysia's Hai-O Enterprise Bhd said it has obtained the approval of the Securities Commission for the listing of its stock on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board.

In a statement late on Tuesday, the retailer of Chinese medicinal products and cooking wines said its listing proposal has already been approved by the Foreign Investment Committee and Ministry of International Trade and Industry.
The listing is now subject to the approval of the stock exchange, it said.
Hai-O, which is also involved in direct sales and making pharmaceutical products, is offering to the public 4.07 million ordinary shares at 3.00 ringgit a share.
